claims: Carlos Boozer has twin sons named Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born in 2007.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are 5-star basketball recruits.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to play for the Duke Blue Devils.
Cayden Boozer is a point guard.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are prospects in the 2025 class.
Cameron Boozer is a power forward/center.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer officially committed to Duke University in October 2024.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer chose the Blue Devils over schools like Miami, Kentucky, and Florida.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer led their AAU team Nightrydas Elite to multiple Peach Jam titles.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer have won gold medals with USA Basketball.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer have an older brother named Carmani.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were identified as genetic matches to help treat their older brother Carmani.
Carmani was diagnosed with sickle cell disease.
